semantics: Field/window selections are intersections on the original MS; an empty result falls back to all rows. Empty TaQL retains the field/window base. Invalid TaQL returns False after committing that base.
Each predict/corrupt retains its immutable selection; observe resets only the current selection for future operations.
Selected replacement preserves other DATA, MODEL_DATA and CORRECTED_DATA. Prediction sets selected MODEL_DATA to1; CORRECTED_DATA follows DATA on touched rows.
Ordered phases reuse the existing image/component/SD/noise/Jones stages; adjacent additive operations fuse, and the ordinary all-row replacement removes prior phases.
An increment after nonidentity gains adds the new model after those gains: constant receptor gain2 distinguishes4A+B from4(A+B).
Query evaluation and selected-run/mask/model scratch are bounded by admitted read/write batches. No dataset-sized retained selection bitmap.

Exact C++ readback checks row metadata, TIME, flags, weights, sigma and preserved cells. Deterministic changed DATA uses NRMS1e-3; independent random draws use support and five-standard-error mean/variance tests.

Row-query types are checked for every operand before row evaluation. Numeric division, floor division, signed modulo, powers and IEEE comparisons follow CASA through the existing table evaluator; no local duplicate math path.

full_simulation.note: Two subprocess helpers are executed by their parent tests. Runtime source b45f0616a; unit-harness adaptation1b91b3b57; export helper438bb0ed5 does not alter calculation.

scalar_arithmetic.scope: Exact CASA result types and values: real/floor division, signed modulo, large integer powers, IEEE infinity/NaN/zero ordering, and invalid Boolean arithmetic.

limits: This outcome proves GridFT selection combinations. Existing WProjectFT, mosaic, SDGrid, flagged-sample, Tsys and tropospheric controls are regression gates, not new all-selection-mode CASA evidence.

Supported predicate columns: ANTENNA1, ANTENNA2, TIME, FIELD_ID, DATA_DESC_ID, SCAN_NUMBER; scalar functions abs/near/nearabs. Other MAIN columns, functions and query forms remain explicit #1053 refusals. Complex ordered predicates remain an explicit refusal.
Existing MS layout restrictions remain; no claim of complete simulation equivalence.
